remarks: Welcome home to this inviting 1-bedroom apartment, perfect for those seeking both comfort and convenience. Step inside to find beautifully maintained hardwood floors throughout, creating a warm and elegant ambiance. The bedroom is bright and spacious, offering a peaceful retreat.  Enjoy the ease of included heat and cooking gas, making your living experience comfortable and budget-friendly. Additional perks include convenient shared laundry facilities and extra storage space located in the basement.  Discover the charm and comfort of this hidden gem-an ideal place to call home! Schedule your visit today!
